name: Houlihan
role: Pipe fitter at the Medora slaughter-house
mentions: Contractor McGee finishes the work on the slaughter-house to-day. The building is pronounced by those who should know as equal to any building of its kind in the United States.
There has been an immense amount of piping and fitting done at the slaughter-house and Messrs. Tibbetts and Houlihan have received many compliments for the superiority of their work.
